recognize_zh: 高倍下積液細胞塊中的腫瘤細胞很大，核圓或不規則、染色質呈泡狀、核仁明顯，部分核偏心且細胞質偏嗜雙性，呈免疫母細胞／漿母細胞樣，並夾雜多形性大細胞，符合原發性積液淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, many 3-4 times the size of a small lymphocyte
Round to irregular, sometimes eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin
Prominent single central or multiple nucleoli (immunoblastic/plasmablastic)
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; occasional pleomorphic and multinucleated forms
Scattered apoptotic bodies and admixed red blood cells in a fibrinous background
describe_en: Cell block of effusion fluid at high power shows a dense aggregate of large, discohesive atypical lymphoid cells embedded in fibrin. The cells have round to irregular, occasionally eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and a moderate amount of amphophilic cytoplasm; occasional pleomorphic and multinucleated forms and apoptotic bodies are present. There is no epithelial or mesothelial architecture. The morphology is that of an immunoblastic/plasmablastic high-grade lymphoma, consistent with primary effusion lymphoma in the appropriate context (HHV8 LANA-1+, CD45+, CD30+, CD138+, CD20-).

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma usually presents as a mass (oral cavity, GI) and is HHV8 LANA-1 negative, whereas PEL is effusion-based and LANA-1 positive.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving effusion
ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and is T-cell/ALK marker positive, while PEL is HHV8+ with plasma cell-associated markers.

ddx.dx: Metastatic poorly differentiated carcinoma or melanoma
ddx.vs: These are CD45 negative and express keratin or S100/SOX10 respectively, and usually show some cohesion.
